$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings, versioned. Machine-specific grants go to settings.local.json (git-ignored). 'hooks', 'ask', 'deny', the git entries of 'allow', 'attribution', and 'disableAllHooks' and 'permissions.defaultMode', which stay unset, are the process keys (the rule "Process files", ADR 0028); the other 'allow' entries are the commands this project uses. 'allow' covers git commit, which the PreToolUse hook lets through only on a claude/ branch (the rule "Commits and merges", ADR 0021); 'ask' makes every merge, push, rebase, tag and forced branch delete (branch -D) prompt the owner, whatever was approved earlier (the same rule, ADR 0013); a merged branch is deleted with branch -d, which 'allow' covers. 'attribution' is empty so Claude Code adds no Co-Authored-By or PR line, which the same rule forbids. Hooks: PreToolUse refuses a git commit the model attempts off a claude/ branch, runs verify before the others and blocks --no-verify; PostToolUse records which files this session edited; Stop refuses to end a turn that edited code (the folders process.json names, the paths of its process tests included) until verify ran green (ADR 0020, ADR 0075). The project's own 'allow' entries leave out dotnet run and MindfulnessReminder.exe on purpose: any start of a build other than exactly --preview or --detect is a full tray start, which repairs the auto-start entry to that build's path (R-006), so each such start asks first.
